product_wide_rationale: Governs when a session's worktree occupancy rows release across the durable store, the agent transport surface, and the main-checkout authority boundary, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: CD-0179 D1 and D4 released a session's occupancy rows inside the session_vacate commit, before the adapter moved the host session, so a refused move, a destination mismatch, or an unreadable landing left a live session in a worktree whose rows stood released. Amends both clauses: the vacate commit records the relocation request and releases nothing, the adapter-only vacate-landing verb records the readback-verified landing and releases the session's rows in one transaction, every refusal past the commit reports effect_state possible with a recovery that works — the adapter keeps the committed destination so the replay runs from wherever the host session sits, and a completed request's replay resolves with no write while no rows stand — and the replay resolves from the registered main checkout because it writes nothing there. The release always belongs to the readback-verified landing.
title: CD-0179 D1 and D4 release at the verified vacate landing
